s05121.summary: Dana presses Eli about two missed parole check-ins in the rainy office.
Ellis covers for his brother and refuses Eli's order to sit.
Hayes phones in that the review board denied Eli's appeal.
Ellis learns Eli kept appealing and calls out his secret.
Ellis rages at the board while Dana and Nora try to contain him.
Eli silences the room and appeals to Hayes for a signature.
Ellis kicks the chair into the wall, shaking with fury.
Eli steadies his brother and sends him outside to wait.
Eli rights the chair, sits, and quietly submits to the paperwork.

s05122.summary: Tim stands at the microphone for take four and freezes.
Tom urges Tim to try again but he stalls after two words.
Tim pockets the lyrics and dismisses the song as noise.
Tom enters the booth and admits Tim's father was afraid too.
Tim laughs and teases Tom for being a bad liar.
Tom returns to the desk and Tim finally speaks his defiant words.

s05123.summary: The orange-jersey team settles into the booth amid screaming crowds.
Priya nitpicks Lia's crosshair and Lia snaps that Omar is coach.
Zed insists on always going left despite Priya's and Omar's doubts.
Their name is mispronounced and Priya reveals Lia's mother brought a sign.
Omar calms the team by promising free pizza.
The countdown runs while the team whispers conflicting directions.

s05124.summary: Nell hurries down a humming backstage corridor and hears a door latch.
Nell senses something wrong while Rook orders her toward the vault.
Nell stops but the squeaking footsteps behind her continue.
Neil steps from a doorway with a drill case, smiling wrongly.
Rook says Neil is in the van; Nell realizes this man is not.
Guard Bram appears and asks which of them is not on his list.
The light dies and a single gunshot rings out in the dark.

s05125.summary: Gloria narrates and meets twin parolees wearing the same issued tie.
Pete patches through her husband Frank, who nags Gloria about eating.
Harlan keeps sipping from an empty cup while he waits.

s05127.summary: Leo takes position by the cake table and Leon starts the countdown.
Leo tracks the bride's choker and her uncle drifting to the exit.
A terrier in a bow tie trots by, unsettling Leo's plan.
Leo calmly accepts champagne from the waiter as the count runs down.
On Leon's mark the lights die and Leo vanishes.

s05128.summary: Three teens ride a rainy night bus until Bri's mom texts.
Bri panics about her mom and Ash pushes her to answer.
Teo shushes them and the three bicker about the driver hearing.
Bri mentions a video and Ash dodges Teo's questions about it.
After a hard brake, Ash realizes the bus has left the route.
The radio dies and the driver coldly orders them to sit.

s05130.summary: Hollis spins the van relocation as growth to his fired, cramped team.
Dispatch reports HR expects zero employees aboard the van.
Marisol demands answers and Hollis admits he called them assets.
Priya shoves the cabinet screaming and Tomasz slams the brakes.

s05132.summary: Pauline tends the fryer in her chip van while June wipes counters.
Pauline reads June's worried look, like their mother's before Leeds.
Graham from council licensing leans in about the pitch.
June quietly realizes the pitch has already been sold off.
Pauline fixes a smile and insists on frying Graham free chips.
Graham eats a chip and praises it; Pauline cites forty years.

s05133.summary: Dev drives at 2 AM, attempting small talk that gets shut down.
Luke calls Nadia furious, demanding to know if the guy is there.
The scared teen lowers his hood and Dev realizes this isn't a ride.
Marcus opens the bag of cash and Dev brakes into a skid.
Dev pleads about his daughter and review while Luke shouts.

s05134.summary: Maya waits alone in a sleety skate park, her group chat emptying.
Jalen climbs the fence and they meet in person for the first time.
An unknown warning text arrives and Maya suspects Jalen sent it.
The light dies, a car door slams, and they hide behind concrete.
Jalen asks for her trust as footsteps crunch closer.

s05135.summary: The nurse gently questions pale Tess on the bathroom floor.
Tess hides her hand and Kira spots tape on her elbow.
Kira and Bea fight over whether to tell about Tess's habit.
The nurse stops and asks which girl is Ms. Hadley's daughter.
Margaret appears in the doorway, very calm, greeting her daughter.
The nurse urges an ambulance and Tess whispers sorry to her mom.

s05136.summary: Producer, intern, singer and brother settle into a late recording session.
Kessler tells Kim her heartbreak song sounds like ordering coffee.
Kim riffs that heartbreak is standing in line; Kip loves it.
Kessel fumbles over notes and claims he wrote the bridge.
Kim says she wrote the part where she leaves.
Kip stands and asks if she's leaving them or the song.
Kim admits she doesn't know and calls to roll; take forty-two.

s05138.summary: Barry drives a silent woman with a violin case through rain.
Her phone orders her to bring the case and not be clever.
Barry chats about orchestras and his trombone mishap; she smiles slightly.
At a dark auction house, a black-coated quartet greets Mrs Vance.
She tips Barry using a surname he never told her.
The violin case is empty, sized for a painting; Barry understands.
She tells Barry to wait and walks off into the rain.
Barry considers his options and calmly switches off the engine.

s05139.summary: A family and neighbour wait out a 1974 blackout by candlelight.
The phone rings; Frank tells Eleanor the hospital called for Gerald.
Eleanor deflects Gerald's question as Olive and Dot urge silence.
A pencilled appointment shows Gerald knew; the children sense it too.
Gerald closes the catalogue and quietly asks Eleanor to make tea.

s05140.summary: Priya films an interview with the guarded old man at his unit.
Teo warns the Okafor name is false before the call drops.
Walt opens the unit, revealing chairs and stacked military crates.
Walt admits he was never in the unit he claimed.
Three movers arrive for Mr. Okafor and Walt tells them to wait.
Priya opens a crate full of names; Walt vows to stop lying.

s05141.summary: Quinn files exhausted Marisol's nails while a stranger waits by the door.
Marisol admits her hands shake before closing arguments; Quinn reassures her.
The trench-coated woman addresses Marisol, who refuses to turn.
Dolores names herself the witness's mother; Marisol orders her out.
Dolores accuses Marisol of branding her truthful son a liar.
Marisol stands and defends her job as a promise to her client.
Dolores hurls her cup, shattering a wall of polish bottles.
Quinn steps between them, begging both women to stop.

s05142.summary: Online strangers meet in a library and Jamal teases Lena's height.
All phones buzz with a welcome from a nonexistent fourth member.
The Orbit speaks through all three phones, claiming the message.
Silent Okoye rises, relieved, saying he told them it was real.
Lights dim blue and the screens read Home; Jamal backs away.
Lena begs Okoye to deny it; he always knew; Orbit thanks them.

s05143.summary: Tessa sets up a livestream while Cam eyes a tote bag.
Tessa goes live and brushes off Cam's nervous worry.
They dance and Cam spots a woman watching without blinking.
Cam stops dancing, insisting the newspaper woman is a cop.
The woman walks toward them as the live chat warns them to run.
A flash mob erupts and the pair bolt for the gate laughing.
Detective Roy waits at the gate and asks about the bag.
Tessa claims props; Mara holds out her hand, unconvinced.

s05146.summary: On a 1953 night bus, the woman in green watches another passenger.
The veiled woman twists her ring, knowing she's being watched.
She reaches into her handbag; the watcher stiffens, but it's a handkerchief.
The woman in green finally claims she dropped something.
She holds up a soaked letter bearing the other's name and keeps it.
She implies she controls where the other woman gets off.
Eleanor names herself; the other says she wrote the letter.

s05147.summary: Ex-detective Jess wipes down benches as her narration introduces her.
A hooded man arrives before opening, seeking her old detective skills.
He slides over a photo of his missing sister.
Jess studies the photo's date and demands the man's name.
He names himself Kyle Brandt, known to Jess since the funeral.
Big Mo emerges too casually, asking to join the conversation.
Kyle sees the bloody towel and says Mo saw her last.
Jess grabs a kettlebell and orders Mo to open the back room.
Mo smiles coldly and drops the bloody towel.
A phone rings behind the lockers with the sister's favourite song.

s05149.summary: Kim waits alone in a closed parole office, clock stuck at 9:41.
A grey-haired woman appears, unsurprised, and mistakes him for Kip.
Kim glimpses a shape in the hall and asks who else is here.
She shows his file with red handwriting that is someone else's.
Footsteps approach and Kim begs her to say it's her.
Frozen Kim hears Margaret name the presence behind him as Kip.
The door opens and Kim whispers that Kip is dead; Margaret agrees.

s05151.summary: A cheerful woman greets an empty AA circle and waits for applause.
She jokes about a tough room and admits three days dry.
Her purse wiggles and she passes it off as her shy sponsor.
She reveals two frogs, her ex-husbands Kim and Kip.
Heavy footsteps and a tapping staff descend the stairs.
Brenda whispers she is a centuries-old witch as the staff stops behind her.

s05152.summary: On lockdown day four, Imani hides behind a fridge, calling Jonah.
Jonah tells her to kill the east lights across open floor.
Imani sprints through the office and slams the switches.
The scraping moves away and the interns give her a thumbs up.
The dog barks and the scraping stops, then reverses.
Bleeding Jonah bursts in with an axe: it was never in the vents.

s05154.summary: At a climate protest, Jen and ex Sam bicker over the polar bear.
A bin topples and Mrs. K smacks Big Dave over a falafel.
A barefoot stranger in silver appears; Sam jokes he's Jen's date.
He claims he's from two hundred years ahead and introduces himself.
Oz asks the protesters not to stop.
Pip pops out of the bear stuck in its head; everyone laughs.
Big Dave shares falafel; Oz says hope is extinct in his time.
Mrs. K pats Oz's arm and rallies him to march.

s05155.summary: On a 2 AM bus, Anika steadies her trembling coffee as Riley boards.
Riley makes small talk and guesses Anika is a nurse.
Riley reads Anika's bad shift from how she holds her cup.
Seven missed ward calls; Riley pushes her to ring back, Anika snaps.
Anika confesses missing a boy's crisis during a twelve-minute break.
Coffee spills; Riley offers a napkin and says she looked when she could.
Riley gets up for their stop, urging her to ring the ward.
Anika names Riley unprompted; Riley leaves and watches the bus go.
Anika finally calls the ward to ask about the boy.

s05156.summary: Bedraggled bridesmaid Lucia rides a night bus with a wilting bouquet.
Fellow bridesmaid Katya boards and the two freeze in recognition.
Katya's heels fly into the driver's screen and both laugh.
Lucia relays the bride's cake blame; Katya hotly disputes it.
Delivery guy Winston sits between them and opens a wrong-order pizza.
Reaching for pizza, they realize the bride threatened them both.
The screen announces the future and doors open on silent whiteness.
Lucia offers Katya the bouquet and invites her to step out.
